welcomeTitle: A place for every bottle worth remembering.
welcomeBody: Log a wine in a moment, keep each person's opinion distinct, and let your own history become useful over time.
foundationBody: Your bottles live in your Space. The app keeps working with no signal, and syncs when there is one.
healthUnavailable: No connection · your bottles are safe on this device

auth.signInTitle: Your wine memory, kept for you.
auth.signInBody: Sign in to keep your bottles, notes, and shared tastings inside the Spaces you choose.
auth.localEmulator: Local development mode · no real Google account is used.
auth.signInError: Sign-in could not start. Please try again.
auth.onboardingBody: Choose how you appear and the language you prefer. You can change both later.
auth.onboardingError: Your profile could not be saved. Your choices are still here; try again.
auth.authErrorBody: Va de Vi could not initialize its secure sign-in connection.
auth.sessionErrorTitle: Your private Space could not be opened.
auth.sessionErrorBody: Check the connection and try loading your session again.

space.switchError: That Space could not be opened.

spaces.newBody: Keep a wine memory for two people or bring a whole tasting group together.
spaces.coupleBody: A private Space designed for exactly two active members.
spaces.groupBody: A shared Space for friends, a club, or a recurring tasting table.
spaces.createError: The Space could not be created. Your choices are still here.
spaces.inviteBody: Create a private, single-use link that expires after seven days.
spaces.expiryNote: Share it privately. Anyone with this link can use it once before it expires.
spaces.manageError: That change could not be completed. Reload the Space and try again.
spaces.loadError: This Space is no longer available to your account.
spaces.renameBody: Everyone in this Space sees this name in their switcher.
spaces.renameError: The Space could not be renamed. Try again.
spaces.renameConflict: Someone else renamed this Space while you were typing. Reload and try again.

invitation.title: Join {{space}}.
invitation.body: {{inviter}} invited you to join as {{role}}. Your own notes remain attributed to you.
invitation.singleUse: This link is single-use and expires after seven days.
invitation.acceptError: The invitation could not be accepted. It may have expired or already been used.
invitation.invalidBody: It may have expired, been revoked, or already been used. Ask the inviter for a new link.

about.title: About Va de Vi
about.body: Where your data lives, who can see it, and how to get it back.
about.dataBody: Export everything, review what is stored, or delete a Space or the account.
about.spacesBody: Create a Space, invite someone, or change who can do what.
about.licenseBody: Va de Vi is free software under the AGPL-3.0. Anyone using it over a network is entitled to its source.

pages.logBody: Log a bottle by hand, or scan its barcode. It saves with no signal and syncs later.
pages.sessionsBody: Shared flights will preserve each participant's individual note.
pages.memoryBody: Your private cards, table, timeline, filters, and export will live here.
pages.assistantBody: The evidence-aware companion arrives behind server-authorized tools; no assistant is simulated in this foundation.
pages.notFoundTitle: That page is not in the cellar.
pages.notFoundBody: Return home and choose another path.

quickLog.title: Quick log
quickLog.body: Confirm the wine, add as much or as little as you like, and save even when the restaurant has no signal.
quickLog.identityHelp: Producer and wine name are enough. The wine is saved only when you confirm it.
quickLog.photoHelp: The photo stays private, and its location is removed before it is saved. Adding one is optional — you can always fill in the details by hand.
quickLog.photoError: That photo could not be processed. Your text is still safe and can be saved without it.
quickLog.quotaWarning: This device is running low on storage. Remove older offline photos or continue with text only.
quickLog.logOnlyHelp: Log only records the wine without forcing a tasting questionnaire.
quickLog.descriptorHelp: Choose the cues that will help you remember this wine.
quickLog.requiredError: Add both the producer and wine name before reviewing.
quickLog.saveError: The log could not be saved on this device. Your form is still here.
quickLog.confirmTitle: Is this the wine you want to remember?
quickLog.confirmHelp: Possible duplicates are shown later; Va de Vi never merges wines automatically.

savedBody.offline: It is saved on this device and will sync when you reconnect.
savedBody.saved: It is saved on this device and waiting to sync.
savedBody.needs_attention: It is preserved locally and needs your attention.

quickLog.identifyAction: Scan or read a label instead
quickLog.prefillLabel: Prefill from a wine you have
quickLog.prefillHelp: Copies its details into a new entry — then just change the vintage.

memory.title: Wine Memory
memory.body: Search the bottles and opinions that belong to this Space. Nothing here is public.
memory.clearConfirm: Remove this account's local drafts, private photos, queue, and cached Memory from this device? Synced server data is not deleted.
memory.cached: Showing the private copy saved on this device.
memory.emptyBody: Log your first bottle or change the search filters.
memory.conflictBody: Your local work has not been discarded. Compare both versions and choose what to keep.
memory.saveCopy: Save local as a new copy
memory.loggedOnly: Wine logged without a tasting note
memory.noSessionsTitle: No session in this Memory yet.
memory.noSessionsBody: Create a flight to keep each participant's note separate.
memory.duplicateBody: These records look similar. Nothing is merged until you confirm it.
memory.mergeConfirmBody: {{source}} will be merged into {{target}}. Tastings, bottles, purchases, prices, and evidence move across, and the old name stays searchable.
memory.mergeError: The merge did not run. One of the records may have changed.
memory.editError: The changes could not be saved. Try again.
memory.editConflict: Someone else changed this wine while you were editing. Reload and try again — nothing you typed was sent.
memory.editPhotoError: The photograph could not be stored, so nothing changed. The details will save if you remove it.

evidence.title: Wine evidence
evidence.body: See what is observed, researched, inferred, or personal—and where each researched claim came from.
evidence.wineBody: Claims and sources for a wine by {{producer}}.
evidence.loadingBody: Checking authorized claims and citation metadata for this Space.
evidence.loadError: The evidence could not be loaded. Try again when the connection is available.
evidence.acceptError: The preferred claim could not be changed. Reload and review the current version.
evidence.conflictBody: {{count}} attribute has different values. Choose a preferred claim without deleting the alternatives.
evidence.emptyTitle: No evidence has been added yet.
evidence.emptyBody: Research and manual evidence will appear here with its source and retrieval date.
evidence.noCitations: No external citation — this is not presented as researched evidence.
evidence.rejectError: The claim could not be discarded. Reload and review the current version.
evidence.discardConfirmBody: It will stop showing on this wine. You can research again later.

research.title: Expand this evidence
research.body: Run bounded open-data lookups. New claims stay proposed and always retain their source.
research.disabled: External research is disabled in this deployment. Manual evidence and Wine Memory remain available.
research.entityHelp: Use a Wikidata Q identifier only when you have confirmed the entity. Barcode lookup runs automatically when the wine has one.
research.offline: Research needs a connection. Existing evidence remains available offline.
research.error: The research job could not be completed. Existing evidence was not changed.

warning.missing_barcode: This wine has no barcode for product lookup.
warning.missing_wikidata_entity: No confirmed Wikidata ID was supplied for one or more topics.
warning.no_results: No safe cited facts were found.
warning.partial_results: One or more sources were unavailable; partial results are shown.

picker.help: Choose which entity each name refers to. Only what you pick is researched, and the results still arrive as proposals to accept.
picker.noneFound: We found no matching entities to disambiguate. You can still research the wine's own details from its barcode.

assistant.title: Vicenç Vinyes
assistant.body: Ask about wines already in your active Space. Every result comes from authorized structured data, with evidence made visible.
assistant.privacyBody: This turn is not saved as chat history. Only a redacted tool audit is retained; your message is not copied into it.
assistant.messageLabel: What would you like to find?
assistant.error: Vicenç could not search right now. Wine Memory and normal forms are still available.
assistant.emptyTitle: Start with your own Wine Memory.
assistant.emptyBody: Ask about the wines in your cellar — what you've tried, what you liked, what to open. Vicenç answers only from your own wines.
assistant.contextEmpty: No structured facts have been added for this wine.
assistant.profileInsufficient: {{count}} submitted note so far; at least {{minimum}} are required before describing a preference.
assistant.personalInsufficient: Based on {{count}} of your submitted notes—insufficient for a personal claim.
assistant.personalAverage: Your average is {{score}}, based on {{count}} submitted notes.
assistant.recommendationsBody: Only real wines from the displayed candidate set are ranked. Labels are explanations, not percentages.
assistant.recommendationSample: Based on {{count}} of your submitted notes.
assistant.recommendationSampleInsufficient: Only {{count}} submitted notes for this wine; preference evidence is insufficient.
assistant.pricesCoverage: Coverage is incomplete. Every price shown includes its source type and observation date.

recommendationReason.personal_high_score: High scores in your submitted notes
recommendationReason.price_unknown: No stored price for this candidate
recommendationReason.recent_price: A recent sourced price is available
recommendationReason.would_buy_history: You previously marked that you would buy it
recommendationReason.in_cellar: In your cellar, ready to open
recommendationReason.not_in_cellar: Not in your cellar — one to seek out

assistant.chatNote: This conversation stays only on this device and clears itself after 15 minutes.

homeTools.title: Keep bottles, wishes, and prices useful.
homeTools.cellarBody: Track physical bottles and their lifecycle.
homeTools.wishlistBody: Remember what to buy and why.
homeTools.shopBody: Keep timestamped observations with visible sources.
homeTools.identifyBody: Scan a barcode or read a label, then check every field before saving.

cellar.title: Cellar
cellar.body: Purchases and bottle events stay separate from the wine record. Inventory is always derived from the bottles below.
cellar.cached: Showing the private cellar copy saved on this device. Changes require a connection.
cellar.error: The cellar could not be refreshed. Any cached copy remains available.
cellar.purchaseBody: A purchase can create physical bottles and always creates a timestamped purchase-price observation.
cellar.onlineRequired: Connect to record purchases or lifecycle changes. Cached bottles remain visible offline.
cellar.empty: No physical bottle has been recorded yet.

wishlist.title: Wishlist
wishlist.body: Keep the reason, priority, and target price without turning the wine itself into a status flag.
wishlist.cached: Showing the private wishlist copy saved on this device. Changes require a connection.
wishlist.error: The wishlist change could not be completed. Reload and try again.
wishlist.onlineRequired: Connect to change the wishlist. The cached list remains visible offline.

shop.title: Prices
shop.body: Record only prices you actually observed. Source, date, channel, and vintage match stay visible.
shop.cached: Showing saved price observations from this device.
shop.error: Prices could not be refreshed. A cached copy may still be shown.
shop.coverageWarning: External coverage is optional and incomplete. Manual shelf, receipt, merchant, and purchase observations remain useful.
shop.onlineRequired: Connect to record a price. Saved observations remain visible offline.
shop.empty: Choose a wine or record its first price observation.

actions.contentCleared: The proposal content has been cleared.
actions.error: The draft could not be updated. No unconfirmed action was written.

sessions.title: Tasting sessions
sessions.body: Build an ordered flight, keep every opinion individual, and compare only submitted notes.
sessions.cached: Showing the private session copy saved on this device.
sessions.emptyBody: Create a first flight from wines already in this Space.
sessions.newBody: Choose a time and an initial flight. You can do this offline with wines already saved on this device.
sessions.flightHelp: Choose known wines now or add them later. Their order remains stable.
sessions.noWines: There are no saved wines to add yet. You can still create the session.
sessions.offlineReady: The session and flight can be saved on this device and replayed exactly once.
sessions.saveError: That session change could not be saved. Your local copy is still here.
sessions.loadingBody: Trying the server and the private copy on this device.
sessions.emptyFlight: This flight is empty. Add a known wine below.
sessions.comparisonEmpty: A comparison appears after participants submit their own notes.

tasting.title: Deep tasting

help.appearance: Notice what is visible without forcing an answer.
help.nose: Capture aroma condition, energy, development, and the cues you want to remember.
help.palate: Describe structure, texture, flavor, and finish with stable 1–5 scales.
help.context: Optional serving and environment details can explain why a wine showed differently.
help.conclusion: Keep the personal verdict yours. A shared session never turns it into someone else's note.

tasting.descriptorHelp: Choose only the cues you actually noticed. Labels stay stable across languages.
tasting.saveError: Your tasting could not be queued. The form is still here.
tasting.conflictBody: Both versions are preserved. Choose the local form or the current server note.
tasting.noConclusion: No conclusion text in this version.

dataRights.title: Data and privacy
dataRights.body: Export what belongs to you, review usage, and delete on your terms.
dataRights.exportBody: JSON is the complete, versioned export. CSV covers one selected table at a time.
dataRights.exportReady: The versioned JSON export (schema {{version}}) was downloaded.
dataRights.mediaBody: Photos are never included automatically. Export the JSON first, then select the photos you want in a ZIP.
dataRights.mediaEmpty: Export the JSON to list the photos you can select.
dataRights.usageBody: Aggregate counts only. No wine name, note, message, or account detail is recorded here.
dataRights.usageUnavailable: The usage report is not available right now.
dataRights.leaveBody: Shared records stay with the Space. You lose access on your next request.
dataRights.deleteSpaceBody: Type the Space name, {{name}}, to confirm. There is a recoverable grace period before anything is purged.
dataRights.deletionScheduled: Deletion is scheduled. You can still cancel it.
dataRights.deletionPending: Data is purged after {{purgeAfter}} unless you cancel.
dataRights.deleteAccountBody: This removes your personal Space and private data. Shared records stay with their Space. A recent sign-in is required.
dataRights.accountScheduled: Account deletion is scheduled in {{days}} days.
dataRights.retentionTitle: What deletion does and does not do
dataRights.retentionBody: Deletion removes active application data and stored photos. Provider-managed backups follow their own retention schedule and are not erased instantly.
dataRights.actionError: That did not work. Check your connection and try again.
dataRights.noticeTitle: What this app does with your data
dataRights.noticeScope: Your wines, tastings, and photos live in the Space you chose. They are visible only to that Space's active members.
dataRights.noticeNoAds: No ads, no sale of data, no public profiles, and no third-party behavioural analytics.
dataRights.noticeMedia: Photos are resized and their location removed on your device before they are saved, and only members of the Space can see them.
dataRights.noticeProviders: Optional AI and research providers are off unless a deployer turns them on, and each has a written privacy review.
dataRights.noticeRetention: Assistant turns are not saved as chat history. Tool audits are redacted and keep no message text.

pwa.installBody: Add it to your device so the app opens instantly and works offline.
pwa.updateBody: Reload to pick up the latest version. Your queued work is kept.
pwa.storageWarning: Offline storage is nearly full. Sync or clear offline data to keep saving photos.
pwa.storageCritical: Offline storage is full. New photos are not kept on this device, but your text notes still save.

identify.title: Identify a bottle
identify.body: Scan a barcode or type what you can read. Nothing is saved until you confirm it.
identify.scanBody: Only the barcode digits are sent. No photo is taken or stored for a scan.
identify.photoAction: Take a photo of the barcode
identify.photoNoBarcode: No barcode found in that photo. Try again closer, or type what you can read.
identify.cameraUnavailable: The camera is unavailable. Type what you can read instead.
identify.scanTimeout: No barcode was found. Try again or type what you can read.
identify.hintLabel: Or type what you can read
identify.noCandidates: Nothing matched. Fill in the details below.
identify.reviewBody: Every field is editable. The wine is created only when you confirm.
identify.identifyError: The search did not run. Check your connection and try again.
identify.confirmError: The wine was not created. Check the fields and try again.

warning.label_unreadable: The label could not be read. Fill the fields in below.
warning.label_reading_disabled: Label reading is switched off in this deployment.
warning.label_text_ignored: Some text on the label was ignored because it read like an instruction.
warning.product_lookup_empty: The public product database has nothing for this barcode.
warning.product_lookup_disabled: Looking barcodes up elsewhere is switched off in this deployment.

winePicker.addHelp: Producer and name are enough. It is saved as a draft, like any wine you log.
winePicker.addError: The wine could not be added. Try again.
